s.how: Blitz 2 avocados with 200g thawed peas, the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint and salt until smooth and very green. Spoon into a bowl and serve with cucumber sticks and water crackers. It is green, it is bold, and it is not sorry about it.

Whisk 3 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in a drop of pink food colouring. Pipe small kisses onto lined trays and bake at 100C for an hour, then cool in the oven. Serve popular and pink with raspberries.

m.note: Elphaba and Galinda's trip to the Emerald City
m.how: Stir 300g arborio rice in butter, then add 1.25L hot stock a ladle at a time for 20 minutes. Blitz 200g peas with 100g spinach and a splash of stock until smooth. Stir through the risotto with more butter and grated parmesan until bright green.

w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Split the batter in two, tint one pink and one green and bake in separate tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Cool and stack with vanilla buttercream made with icing sugar.

d.how: Fill pairs of glasses with ice. Add a splash of lime cordial to one and raspberry cordial to the other. Top both with cold soda water and serve them side by side, one green and one pink, the way two unlikely friends should be.
